text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and mind. First, eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables, and whole grains, and avoid too much sugar and fast food. Second, exercise regularly — even a thirty-minute walk every day makes a big difference. Third, get enough sleep, because your body needs rest to stay strong. Mental health is just as important as physical health, so take time to relax and talk to friends when you feel stressed. Finally, try to keep a good work-life balance. When you spend time on both work and hobbies, you feel happier and more energetic.
